status: Integrated matrix design development; not a fabrication release

basis.soft_supports: Retained R1 conformal saddle geometry on the original TPU
notes: Use the actual fork outlines and each saddle's developed surface, not a generic rectangular fingertip.
The six local matrices are new electrode layouts; no measured F1 force or contact performance exists.

array.row_order: Distal to proximal within each local patch
array.column_order: Increasing native X within each patch; patches follow R1 CH0 through CH5

material_development.piezoresistive_layer_candidate: Same 0.10 mm conductive pressure film used by R1
material_development.electrodes_candidate: Two patterned single-conductor-layer polyimide flex circuits per patch
notes: Select and check the complete active, perimeter-seal, coverlay and tail stack before generating fabrication files.
Keep feed traces insulated from unintended film contact.
The original TPU remains compliant; flex strain, bending artifacts and wear require physical tests.

readout_development.architecture_candidate: Row buffers after the selection switches, actively biased inactive rows, and separate current/sense column multiplexers in the transimpedance feedback loop
notes: A simple floating-row voltage divider is not the selected architecture.
Check finite switch/wire resistance, amplifier offsets, leakage, settling, simultaneous contacts and open connections.
The buffered-path study gives target DC resistances only. Verify actual op-amp load regulation, tail resistance, parked feedback, gain changes and loop stability before calling it a circuit.
Select gain/range using electrical resistance cases; do not label them as force without physical calibration.
